infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Evulto uses your location during runs to track the route and award you the grid cells you pass through in the Territory game.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Evulto uses your camera to analyze your exercise form in real time and to capture physique progress photos. Photos are encrypted on your device before upload.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required by the camera framework but is not used by Evulto.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Evulto accesses your photo library so you can select physique progress photos. Photos are encrypted on your device before upload — we never see the originals.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Evulto may save processed images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Evulto does not access Apple Health data.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Evulto does not write to Apple Health.
infoPlist.NSHealthClinicalHealthRecordsShareUsageD: Evulto does not access clinical health records.
